    • listLocations

      public List<? extends SmartHandsLocation> listLocations(Boolean detail, String ibxs, String cages)
      Description copied from interface: SmartHandsRequests
      Lists the IBX locations, cages and cabinets where the current user may place smart hands orders, optionally filtered.

      Maps to GET /v1/orders/smarthands/locations (getLocation).

      Specified by:
      listLocations in interface SmartHandsRequests
      Parameters:
      detail - when true, returns detailed permission with cages and cabinets, or null for the default
      ibxs - a comma-separated list of IBX codes to filter by (e.g. AM1,AM2), or null
      cages - a comma-separated list of cage ids to filter by (e.g. AM1:02:002MC1), or null
      Returns:
      the list of permitted locations
